decisions.finding: Second consonant Aleph exhibits a fully printed consonant body terminating cleanly at row 543 of extension-volumeA-500-zoom6-mid-right.png. Offline pixel inspection of the entire sublinear band beneath Aleph across cols 1115..1220, rows 544..570 reveals zero ink pixels (100% unprinted white paper). Aleph is an unpointed quiescent consonant without any sublinear vowel mark. Unreadable point disclosure is resolved as unpointed consonant and retired.

Third consonant Zayin terminates at row 501. Directly beneath its stem, at rows 540..566, cols 972..995 of extension-volumeA-500-zoom6-mid-right.png, sits a clear sublinear mark of height 27 px and width 24 px (456 ink pixels) featuring an upper dot mass (rows 544..554), a central pinch/waist, and a lower dot mass (rows 559..565). This height and morphology exactly match the Sheva controls on this line (e.g. Tav Sheva at rows 547..562). Stamped mark is a standard printed Sheva (U+05B0). Note is retired and Sheva is restored to form זְ.
